title: Reduce stock when an order is placed
body:
## Summary

Checkout now subtracts the ordered quantity from product stock.

## Changes

* orders.checkout decrements product stock for each item

## How to test

Check out 2 mice and confirm product 1 stock drops by 2.

verixa_should_cover: Stock drops by the ordered quantity
Two customers with carts that together exceed stock must not oversell (BUG: stock goes negative)
Cart add still blocks quantity above stock
